summary: The supplied evidence supports discoverable setup, tools, verification, safety guidance and feedback storage. Linked architecture documentation and focused topic routing support stronger static capabilities. Domain documentation remains introductory. Explicit risk categories support usable human oversight, while technical enforcement is unknown. Instruction scoping, task decomposition and observability remain unassessed because their defining evidence is insufficient. Environment reliability, test outcomes, maintenance history and habitual workflow usage remain unverified.
